parser.current: Amount and unit are parsed before catalog lookup.
parser.gap: German plural Stücke was not recognized.
parser.fix: Recognize Stück, Stücke, Stueck and Stuecke while preserving existing unit terms.

resolver.current: Explicit units are preserved and unresolved units receive baseValue=null.
resolver.gap: No interaction policy converted safe editable defaults into a temporary calculation option.
resolver.fix: Add a smart-unit policy layer that creates an editable temporary option without changing the frozen catalog evidence model; confirmed values become existing user_calibration records.

genericFoods.current: Nudeln, Reis and Kartoffeln defaulted to 200 g only when no amount or unit was spoken.
genericFoods.gap: An explicit spoken Portion remained unresolved.
genericFoods.fix: Use an editable 200 g default for an explicitly requested generic Portion.

pizza.current: Explicit Stück without proven unit weight remained unresolved.
pizza.gap: A structured whole-product mass was not converted into an editable slice denominator.
pizza.fix: For a mass-based Pizza with structured productQuantity, ask for the whole-pizza slice count and default to 8; otherwise request the real unit weight instead of guessing.

multiProduct.current: Unresolved items were discarded from the meal and reopened as one search failure.
multiProduct.fix: Retain calculable editable defaults as meal items and retain unknown-size units as explicit pending items, each with its own prompt.

architectureDecision.reason: Keep the existing catalog controller and calculator screen stable; add a narrow controller adapter and accessible overlay for smart-unit state.
